## 💡 Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of the capability or improvement you are proposing.

## 🎯 Behavioral / Operational Problem It Solves
What friction, cognitive rationalization, or developer workflow issue does this solve?
*(e.g. "I often underestimate 90-minute blocks when switching between CLI and web dashboard.")*

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution / Experience
Describe the workflow or interface changes:
- For Web: (UI layout, interactive telemetry, modal behavior)
- For CLI: (Command syntax, flags, terminal table structure)
- For MCP: (New tool schema, parameters, return format)

## 📌 Alternative Solutions Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## ➕ Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
